notes: Your spellbook, your rules. The panel now lists EVERY spell on your hotbars — with their in-game icons — not just the ones the plugin's database knows. Spells the database recognises keep their built-in behaviour; anything else lands in an 'Unassigned' group where you click its Type cell and tell the assistant what it is: Damage (nuke enemies), Instakill (DC), Crowd control (DC) or Heal. The plugin auto-suggests a type where it can (spell school + saving throw), finds the spell's real server cooldown automatically, and each spell has its own on/off checkbox. Assigned damage spells are fired at valid targets between your DC casts and never feed the ward-learning logic.
